post.description: Generic: v1=HMAC-SHA256(secret,timestamp+'.'+rawBody), +/-300s. GitHub: sha256=HMAC-SHA256(secret,rawBody); no timestamp freshness. Deduplication key is endpoint + source ID. Same ID with different body returns 409. JSON body <=256KiB. Duplicate returns 200. Generic bodies must include a string id equal to X-Event-ID; this binds source identity to signed bytes. GitHub supports issues and ping, and deduplicates by delivery ID or signed body hash, so changed unsigned headers cannot multiply delivery. Identical GitHub bytes represent one logical event per endpoint.
